skill.name: context-fundamentals
skill.description: Explains context engineering fundamentals for AI agents, including context windows, attention budgets, progressive disclosure, and context quality. Use it for onboarding, documentation, and first-principles reasoning before applying operational context techniques.
skill.summary: Learn the core mental models behind context engineering for AI agents.
skill.author: muratcankoylan

security_audit.summary: All static external-command and blocker findings are false positives caused by Markdown or Python documentation backticks and context-engineering terminology. No shell execution, network access, prompt-injection text, or host reconnaissance was found in the cited lines. Two medium semantic risks remain: unrestricted file paths in the helper class and a system-role summary injection pattern in documentation.

remediation.suggestion: Resolve summary_path and detail_path under base_dir, reject absolute paths, and block path traversal before opening files.

remediation.issue: Generated conversation summaries are shown as system-role messages.
remediation.suggestion: Use a lower-trust role or explicit memory field, and label user or tool-derived summary content before reuse.

semantic_findings.title: Unconstrained File Loading Helper
semantic_findings.description: ProgressiveDisclosureManager stores a base_dir but load_summary and load_detail open caller-provided paths directly. If a host app passes untrusted reference data, the helper can read unintended local files.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code directly opens summary_path and detail_path without validating them against base_dir. The risk depends on whether callers pass untrusted paths.

semantic_findings.title: Generated Summaries Elevated To System Role
semantic_findings.description: The summary injection example inserts generated conversation summaries as role system messages. If summaries contain untrusted user or tool content, this can elevate lower-trust content above its original authority.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The pseudocode explicitly creates a system-role summary from prior messages. It is documentation rather than executable code, so impact depends on implementation.

content.value_statement: Context engineering choices can fail when teams do not understand attention budgets and context windows. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code clear mental models for safer context design.
actual_capabilities: Explains what counts as context in an AI agent session.
Describes context windows, token budgets, and effective capacity limits.
Shows why information placement affects model recall and reasoning.
Introduces progressive disclosure for documents, tools, and skills.
Routes operational context work to specialized related skills.
Includes a Python utility for estimating and assembling context.
limitations: It is conceptual and does not diagnose live agent failures.
Token estimates use rough heuristics, not provider tokenizers.
The Python helper is a demo utility, not production-ready security middleware.
It does not replace specialized skills for compression or optimization.

use_cases.title: Onboard AI Agent Teams
use_cases.description: Teach contributors the shared vocabulary behind context windows, attention budgets, and progressive disclosure.

use_cases.title: Review Context Documentation
use_cases.description: Ground documentation in clear concepts before describing operational context practices.

use_cases.title: Plan Agent Architecture
use_cases.description: Reason about which context constraints matter before selecting compression, retrieval, or optimization tactics.

prompt_templates.title: Explain Context Basics
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner onboarding for a new AI agent contributor.
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain what context means in an AI agent session. Cover system prompts, tools, documents, messages, and outputs in simple terms.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Quality And Quantity
prompt_templates.scenario: A team believes a larger context window will solve reliability problems.
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain why more context can reduce answer quality. Include attention budgets, effective capacity, and the lost-in-the-middle effect.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate A Context Design
prompt_templates.scenario: A product engineer wants first-principles feedback before choosing tactics.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this context design from first principles. Identify attention risks, low-signal content, and where progressive disclosure would help.

prompt_templates.title: Build A Learning Path
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning for a team adopting multiple context-engineering skills.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a learning path for engineers moving from context fundamentals to degradation diagnosis, optimization, compression, and file-based context.

output_examples.input: A product team asks why a larger context window did not improve answer quality.
output_examples.output: Explains effective capacity, attention dilution, and why high-signal placement matters more than raw token capacity.

output_examples.input: A technical writer needs a section about progressive disclosure.
output_examples.output: Defines progressive disclosure and gives practical examples for loading skills, documents, and tool outputs only when needed.

output_examples.input: An engineer wants to decide whether this skill handles compaction work.
output_examples.output: Clarifies that the skill explains why compaction matters, then routes implementation details to a compression-focused workflow.

best_practices: Use it first when a team needs shared language before choosing tactics.
Pair concepts with real agent examples from the target workflow.
Verify token budgets with provider tokenizers before production use.
anti_patterns: Using this skill to perform compression or retrieval work directly.
Assuming nominal context size equals reliable usable capacity.
Loading every related document instead of selecting high-signal context.

faq.question: Does this skill run commands?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and a demo Python utility, but the cited skill content does not execute shell commands.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: It supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it useful for beginners?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains foundational context engineering terms before advanced operational skills.

faq.question: Does it optimize prompts automatically?
faq.answer: No. It helps reason about context choices and points to specialized optimization skills.

faq.question: Can it help with lost-in-the-middle issues?
faq.answer: It explains the concept, but diagnosis belongs in a specialized context degradation workflow.

faq.question: Is the included Python helper production ready?
faq.answer: No. It is a demonstration and should be hardened before use with untrusted inputs.
